gui.wandscape.confirm.cancel.msg.zh_cn: 确定要撤销「%s」的建造吗？已建部分将一并清除，只退还未开工或未建成部分的建材。
gui.wandscape.confirm.cancel.msg.en_us: Are you sure you want to cancel construction of '%s'? Whatever is already built is cleared too, and only unbuilt materials are returned.

gui.wandscape.confirm.demolish.msg.zh_cn: 确定要拆除「%s」吗？已下发的工作将中断，拆除不再返还任何建材。
gui.wandscape.confirm.demolish.msg.en_us: Are you sure you want to demolish '%s'? Ongoing work will stop and no materials are returned.
